earnings.title: GRAINGER REPORTS RESULTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER 2026
highlights: Generated diluted EPS of $12.42 on a reported basis, up 102.9%, or $12.54 on an adjusted basis, up 22.8%

CHICAGO, November 4, 2026 - Grainger (NYSE: GWW) today reported results for the third quarter of 2026 with sales of $5.2 billion, up 11.3%, or 14.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis, and adjusted diluted EPS of $12.54, up 22.8% compared to the third quarter of 2025.
Delivered sales of $5.2 billion, up 11.3%, or 14.9% on a daily, organic constant currency basis

Achieved operating margin of 16.0% on a reported basis, up 500 basis points, or 16.1% on an adjusted basis, up 90 basis points, which excludes certain non-recurring items, notably the loss related to the Company's exit of the U.K. market in the prior year period

quotes.text: The third quarter performance reflects our consistent execution and an improving demand environment.

outlook: Increasing full year 2026 earnings outlook, including diluted adjusted EPS range of $47.00 to $48.00
Daily, organic constant currency sales growth 11.5% - 13.0% 13.0% - 14.5%

items.heading: Disruptions in Grainger’s supply chain could result in an adverse impact on results of operations.

Weakness in the economy, market trends and other conditions affecting the profitability and financial stability of Grainger’s customers could negatively impact Grainger’s sales growth and results of operations.

Unexpected product shortages, product cost increases and risks in trade and tariff policies associated with Grainger’s suppliers could negatively impact customer relationships or result in an adverse impact on results of operations.
Volatility in commodity prices may adversely affect gross margins.
Fluctuations in foreign currency could have an effect on reported results of operations.

The facilities maintenance industry is highly competitive, and changes in competition and other risks could increase our costs, impact demand for Grainger’s products and services or impact the profitability of our business.
